description: Shortlist Italian mobile plans using the website catalogue and the same resolved monthly fees as the website. Default: consumer candidates, price ascending, 10 results, Italian links. Null is unknown; prices exclude other charges. Conditional quotes retain their qualifications. Use get_product for fee and allowance timelines, one-off costs and full conditions. Only listed filters are supported.

current_operator.description: Current operator ID. Known port-in exclusions retain new-number alternatives; check entry_paths and eligibility before promising number retention.

locale.description: Website link language; source terms may remain Italian.

max_monthly_price_eur.description: Maximum displayed comparable monthly equivalent. Qualified quotes retain their conditions; unknown prices do not match.

providers.description: Exact provider IDs from results; unknown IDs are rejected.

name: search_mobile_plans
